Shri Pranay Joshi - G.A./P.L. for respondent No.1/State
 Shri Rakesh Kumar Sharma - Advocate for respondent
 No.2/prosecutrix.

2] This petition has been filed by the petitioner u 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the FIR lodged at Crime No.411 of 2021, Police Station - Manasa,
District Neemuch under Sections 366 and 376 (2)(F) of IPC and the subsequent charge-sheet.

3] This petition has been filed along with I.A. No.10436 of 2024, which is an application filed under Section 320(2) of Cr.P.C. for leave of this Court to compromise the matter and I.A. No.10438 of 2024 which is an application filed under Section 320 of Cr.P.C. for compounding the offence and quashing the FIR and the charge-sheet.
2 MCRC-27017-2024 4] In brief, the facts of the case are that the aforesaid FIR was lodged against the petitioner alleging abduction and rape of the prosecutrix, the respondent No.2 herein.
The story of the prosecution is that a missing person report was lodged on 09.10.2021, whereas the prosecutrix was recovered on 14.10.2021, who has stated that she was lured by the petitioner.

5] Counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the prosecutrix, being a major, aged 21 years, was a consenting party and subsequently the differences between them have also been settled as is apparent from the two interlocutory applications filed by parties along with the affidavit of the prosecutrix and she was directed to appear before the Principal Registrar of this Court to record her consent and the Principal Registrar in its report dated 02.08.2024 also opined that the consent given by the respondent No.2 was free from any coercion.
Thus, it is submitted that the FIR and the charge-sheet may be quashed and the case may be closed.

sentences.text: 6] Counsel for the respondent No.2/prosecutrix has submitted that the application may be allowed.
7] Counsel for the State, however, has opposed the prayer.

Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the case-diary and the fact that the prosecutrix was major at the time of incident and she has also recorded her consent before the Principal Registrar of this Court for closing the matter.

In view of the same, 3 MCRC-27017-2024 I.A.No.10436 of 2024 and I.A.
No.10438 of 2024 stand allowed.

9] Consequently, the petition stands allowed, and the FIR lodged at Crime No.411 of 2021, Police Station Manasa, District Neemuch under Sections 366 and 376 (2)(F) of IPC and the subsequent charge- sheet and the further proceedings are hereby quashed.
10] With the aforesaid, the petition stands allowed and disposed of.
